scope: independent root audit of the actual fixed-M j1 Hasse-transverse pair, compulsory-prime de-overlap, boundary clearing, CRT radical, gate elimination, Frobenius form, and capacity scope

checks.canonical_scope_repair: made the Item197 height estimate explicitly conditional on C0(M) being nonzero; the unconditional raw ceiling remains in the zero case

mathematical_audit.selector: solving p=4h+6s+3 and M=3h+4s+2 gives h=3M-2p, s=(3p-4M-1)/2 and exactly the stated prime interval
mathematical_audit.compulsory_copy: Item197 gives p|C0,C1 for every candidate; because P_M is squarefree, division by P_M removes one and only one compulsory copy globally
mathematical_audit.quotient_bridge: C_nu/p=(P_M/p)*Cbar_nu and Item218 gives C_nu/p=6Q_nu, yielding the stated p-unit bridge
mathematical_audit.boundary: multiplying the terminating Odd tail by (2s+h+2)_h gives the displayed integer Y; every denominator factor is positive and below p
mathematical_audit.union: on f0=0 the syzygy becomes 2H=-y*f1, so the joint pair is exactly the union of the full gate and the y-boundary
mathematical_audit.radical: CRT transfers Y_(h_p,s_p) to Z_M primewise; squarefreeness of P_M makes the gcd equal the lcm of the full and boundary radicals
mathematical_audit.resultants: direct symbolic elimination gives Res_y(f0,H)=x*f1 and Res_x(f0,H)=-y*f1; a dense nonzero chart proves the parameter contraction is zero
mathematical_audit.frobenius: the integral Fermat-defect polynomial has coefficient (-1)^(k-1)/k below p and reproduces Q0 itself, not a third coordinate
mathematical_audit.scope_warning: CRT can encode any zero pattern below P_M, so its raw-scale height and the existing conditional coefficient bound yield no weighted saving
